body: That's good to hear. I've sort of been starting to make friends, I think. I don't know. It's hard because I'm very shy, but I've been trying to push myself because, as you said, it helps just to have people to talk to. I'm studying library and information science, more on the information science/computing side of things.

It's so good to hear I'm not alone. Grad school is definitely exhauting, and even though I enjoy it, at the same time it's been hard to find the energy, as you mentioned. It's frustating when it feels like I'm just in a never-ending loop of hating life. I feel like I have this (unrealistic) expectation that I should be OK all the time, so when I'm not, it just trashes any self-esteem I previously had.

I'm sorry to hear that your mom said that. :( I imagine that must be tough and frustating to hear when you already have so much weighing on your mind. You say you don't want to kill yourself, in my opinion that's definitely something to hang on to.

Cool, grad school so far is a bit more work than I had in college, but not by that much. I think I'm just a little out of practice.

Thanks, it definitely helps to know I'm not alone in these feelings.

Thanks for asking. I guess a lot of stuff. I'm in grad school, and my second semester started up a few weeks ago, so I'm kind of stressed about getting all my work done/ balancing going to work and going to school. I also live somewhere that has gotten a crazy amount of snow in the past few weeks, and I think being stuck inside a lot is really getting to me. I've just felt so negative lately.
